self_checks.name: Change-rate guard
self_checks.evidence: Reviewed official verify_gates.py reports for all 29 complete deterministic body chunks: every exit code is 0; official rounded rates span 0% to 0.12%. No whole-corpus SequenceMatcher rate or weighted substitute is claimed.

self_checks.name: Genre preservation
self_checks.evidence: The edits retain visual-novel dialogue, narration, first-person perception, tense shifts, short horror fragments, and branch repetitions. Essay is only the metric proxy. Seolhwa visibility remains protagonist-specific in the inspected perception scenes and every changed record.

self_checks.name: Register preservation
self_checks.evidence: All changed dialogue preserves peer banmal, teacher-directed polite speech and requests. No formal register was raised or lowered and no character voice was homogenized.

self_checks.name: Absolute zero residual S1
self_checks.evidence: No confirmed harmful S1 finding was established in the changed records and diagnosed editable candidates. Four editable speech pauses and four immutable connective-comma candidates remain explicitly reported. A fresh manual reread of all 171,544 source characters is not claimed, so the checklist absolute zero-S1 guarantee is not certified.

self_checks.name: No artificial insertion or overediting
self_checks.evidence: The 25 incoming changes remove or repair localized punctuation, clarify the two repeated forms of nawa, and correct a visual verb paired with a request to hear an account. They add no facts, metaphors, cliches, demands, or emotional softening. The finalizer makes no further body changes.

finalizer.grade_basis: Conservative scoped grade: five checklist items verified and no confirmed harmful editable S1/S2 finding. The absolute corpus-wide zero-S1 checklist item is not certified; the very low chunk change rates also do not meet the A-grade 10%-25% rate condition.

*목소리는 들렸다. 하지만 욕실 문도, 환풍구도, 스피커도 울리지 않는다.*

미안하다는 말은 들었어. 어디서 들리는지는 모르겠는데, 들었어. 설화야, 나한테 하는 말 맞지?

*몸이 움직이고 발끝이 비상구 쪽으로 꺾였다. 유나의 손을 잡고 뛰었다.*

유나야, 손 놓지 마. 문 밖까지 같이 가자. 뒤에서 불러도 돌아가지 말고, 지금은 나 따라와.

*놓으면 빨라질 것 같아 손에 힘을 더 줬다.*

선배, 손 아파요. 놓지는 말고, 조금만 느슨하게요.

*선생님이 붉은 눈가로 고개를 든다.*

기록이 남아 있는 건 아시네요. 그럼 말로 미안하다고만 하지 말고, 이제 어떻게 하실지 얘기하세요.

residual_findings.reason: Four pre-existing dialogue or quoted-dialogue candidates remain in immutable records. They were inspected as residual candidates and preserved exactly. An absolute whole-corpus zero-C-11 claim is withheld.

Of 18 remaining broad-regex matching records, 10 match interjections, lexical noun endings, or imperatives rather than the targeted connective-comma pattern. The screen is an audit count, not a finding count.

These objections preserve the protagonist asking for an answer, identifying who blocks the exit, and refusing enforced silence. They occur in different scenes and are not an adjacent mechanical sequence. Removing them would soften the character or erase causality.
The matches are auxiliary-particle or parallel-modifier artifacts, not three nested relative clauses. Their wording and clue terms remain unchanged.

resolved_findings.reason: French written J’en bois plus can be read as more or no more when ne is omitted; the source explicitly declines any further drink. Its causal question c’était ça is also needlessly elliptical. German war das hiervon is not idiomatic for asking whether the drink caused the dizziness. Both replacements keep the uncertainty, quick recovery, refusal, and exact 0.5/1-second visual disturbance without asserting that the drink caused it.
